decisions.name: Remove dead air

max_gap_ms.description: Silences at least this long are cut

keep_ms.description: Breathing room kept around each cut

decisions.rationale: Dead air is the first thing viewers scroll past; keeping a short pause preserves natural rhythm.

decisions.name: Remove filler words

words.description: Per-language filler list. Add 'like' or 'you know' only if the speaker overuses them.

decisions.rationale: Fillers read as unprepared; cutting them is the cheapest perceived-quality gain.

decisions.name: Trim audible breaths
decisions.rationale: Softer alternative to silence_remove for calm formats: shortens breath gaps instead of removing them.

decisions.name: Jump cut on sentence boundaries
decisions.rationale: Cuts on sentence ends feel invisible; cuts mid-sentence feel like mistakes (rule F1).

decisions.name: Trim dead air at start and end
decisions.rationale: A video must start on the first word; the hook clock starts at frame 0.

decisions.name: Max single shot length by format
decisions.rationale: When no cut is available, a visual change (punch-in or crop change) must happen within the max shot length (rule P1).

decisions.name: Hook-first reorder
decisions.rationale: Open on the strongest self-contained line; keep or drop the original intro (rule F5).

decisions.name: Speed up slow sections slightly
decisions.rationale: A 5% speed-up is below the threshold most viewers notice and recovers time without cuts.
